title: German Peach Cobbler
description: A traditional German-style peach cobbler with a silky, crispy crust. Perfect for a warm summer evening.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine sliced peaches and granulated sugar. Let it sit for 15 minutes.
In another bowl, mix biscuit mix, flour, and melted butter until a dough forms.
Roll out the dough and place it on top of the peach mixture.
In a small bowl, whisk eggs and vanilla extract. Brush this mixture on top of the dough.
Bake in the preheated oven for 35-40 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown.
Serve warm with vanilla ice cream or whipped cream, if desired.
